title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE EVENING BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding $62,200 after a muted session—up less than one percent on the day. We're trading in a compressed range with conviction nowhere to be found.

Here's what matters: Fear and Greed at 12. Extreme Fear. That's capitulation territory, historically a contrarian buy signal, but the market's still digesting macro headwinds. Network health remains solid—hashrate steady at 852 EH/s, no miner capitulation signals yet.

The mempool's loose with 50K transactions sitti
